lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11-13 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is dense near the shoulder, widening significantly across the mid-torso, and becoming regularly spaced on the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One visible Y-shaped bifurcation observed on the upper third of the third line from the posterior edge, where the line splits before reaching the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Three anterior lines terminate abruptly mid-torso without reaching the ventral line; one posterior line is fragmented into two segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of 5-6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two circular spots on the mid-posterior thigh align horizontally to form a geometric pair.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns emerge with an upward-lateral trajectory, following a lyrate curvature that twists outward then inward relative to the skull base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately 18% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white markings present on the pasterns of all visible limbs and a white chevron pattern is visible on the nasal bridge.
